en: Sepia-toned photograph of a richly decorated Gothic Revival church interior, centered on a tall stone altar and reredos with pointed arches, pinnacles, and statues of saints. Behind the altar are large stained-glass windows; on either side are side aisles with traceried railings and coats of arms. Statues stand in niches to the left and right. In the foreground is a baptismal font or lectern on a small pedestal, with steps leading up to the sanctuary.
